recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant text for FHIR-5789 unless a future vocabulary work-group decision changes $expand filter or date semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5789 was a Published FHIR-core ValueSet change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1, asking whether ValueSet $expand filter/date input parameters should be clarified. The final decision required server-delegated filter interpretation and date behavior based on value set/code system definitions as of the supplied date, or an error when that is not possible.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SVN revision 5689. No current git commit mentioning FHIR-5789 or revision 5689 was found for the active ValueSet $expand source, but git history shows the current OperationDefinition XML introduced in the 2021 source rework already contained the requested date and filter wording. A 2025 ValueSet operation-parameter commit refined filter support while preserving the server-delegated semantics.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and its operation list references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand, with terminology-service and ValueSet narrative pages linking to the generated operation page. Broader Jira checks found related expansion-parameter and terminology-capability work, but no later decision that reverses the FHIR-5789 filter/date semantics. Zulip and Confluence searches for the seed key and exact date-resolution phrase found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current operation definition already says filter interpretation is delegated to the server and date requires using value set/code system definitions as they were on the supplied date or returning an error if that is not possible.

related_jiras.note: Later Published ValueSet $expand issue clarifying safe reuse and recording of expansion-affecting parameters; it does not change FHIR-5789's filter/date semantics.
Later terminology capability work makes TerminologyCapabilities relevant to documenting text-filter behavior, which the current filter documentation references.
